data.rationale: The proposal matches the true steps in order (Check my bus, Track my bus, Service Number tab, type the service number) and names service_number as the parameter. It adds an optional location step and a final submit click that the true workflow doesn't clearly include, which makes the spec slightly vague, but a automation could still be built from it.
